codes.summary: No conversion record has this `conversion_id` on this instance (it never existed, or it passed report retention).
The uploaded file existed but its retention window has passed and its bytes were deleted. Re-upload to convert again; any conversion report it produced remains readable.
No uploaded file has this `file_id` on this instance.
The upload exceeds this instance's size limit. There is no size limit on the CLI or a self-hosted instance — see the self-hosting guide.
No format with this id is registered on this instance. See the capabilities endpoint for the supported set.

The trajectory's frame count exceeds this instance's `max_frames` limit; the job was refused during the streaming read (counted as it streams, before the remaining frames are parsed). `details.frame_count` and `details.max_frames` state the numbers.
A framework-level HTTP error with no more specific code. The `request_id` links to the server log with the detail.
An unexpected server error. The message is deliberately generic; quote the `request_id` when reporting it so the server-side detail can be found.
The `cursor` passed to a paginated listing is not one this service issued. Start from the first page and follow `next_cursor` values only.
A supplied recovery choice does not match the paused conversion's offered scenario or its allowed values.
The job is already `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`, or `expired`, so the requested transition (e.g. cancel) no longer applies.
A recovery resolution was posted to a job that is not paused at `awaiting_recovery`.
No job has this `job_id` on this instance.
The request body or parameters failed validation (a missing field, a wrong type, an unparseable body). `details.errors` lists each field-level failure.
The path exists but does not accept this HTTP method.
The requested feature (e.g. accounts) is not enabled on this instance. It answers 404 so a disabled feature is indistinguishable from an absent one.
No route matches the requested path and method. Check the URL against the API reference.
The converted output's bytes have passed their retention window and were deleted. The conversion report remains readable; re-run the conversion to regenerate the file.
The format was identified but the file could not be parsed; recorded on the failed job, with the parse issues in `details.issues`.
Too many requests in the current window. The `Retry-After` header says when to try again.
A conversion paused for a recovery decision was not resolved before its window expired, so it resolved to a refusal — never a silently applied default.
This caller already has the maximum number of jobs in flight. Wait for one to finish before submitting another.
This instance requires an API key and the request did not supply a valid one.
The file's format could not be identified with enough confidence to parse it. Pass an explicit format if you know it.
The download is gated because post-conversion validation failed; acknowledge the named failures to proceed. The record keeps showing the failure afterward.
Validation could not be run or re-run for this conversion; recorded on the job.
